words.fa: محل سرو مشروب / ميله / تيرک دروازه

conversation: A: Well Mr. Brakes, where were you yesterday?
A: At 2 o'clock. Where were you at 2 o'clock?
A: You weren't at home. You were in central London.
B: No, I wasn't. I was at home. Ask my girlfriend. She was with me.
A: We are gonna speak to her later. Where is she now?
A: Ok. Where were you on January the 12th?
A: Yes, it was a Wednesday.
B: No, I wasn't. I was in prison in January.
